He must be mistaken.|quotestart=0|[[Unaw Aharo]] sends an emergency message to Derrin Weller|audio=Aharo-Weller-SWTOR.flac|<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />}}
During the early stages of the [[Flesh Raider uprising|conflict]] between the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the native [[Flesh Raider]]s of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], a Flesh Raider force under the command of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Callef]] infiltrated the [[Tythonian Gnarls]] region through a [[Gnarls cave|cliff tunnel]] and '''attacked''' the [[Gnarls Outpost|Jedi outpost]] in the area<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" /> during [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Time" />

Unlike previous assaults, the natives came in greater numbers and were more organized, but under the leadership of [[Warden/Legends|Warden]] [[Derrin Weller]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]] stationed at the outpost were able to wipe out the Flesh Raider assault with minor casualties on their side. During the battle, a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi]] who had been sent by Weller to seal off the attackers' tunnel was [[Duel in the Gnarls cave|successful]] in defeating Callef, before the Jedi Master [[Orgus Din]] collapsed the tunnel with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" /> As a result of the attack, that same young apprentice was later sent to the nearby [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] village of [[Kalikori village|Kalikori]] to learn what the settlers knew of the natives' recent activities.<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attack on the Gnarls Outpost first appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as the first event of the Jedi Knight class in the mission "Attack of the Flesh Raiders."<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />
